त्रिकाण्डमण्डन by Bhāskaramiśra Somayājin. See Āpasta-
mbasūtradhvanitārthakārikā. Quoted in Caturvarga-
cintāmaṇi, Madanapārijāta, Ācārārka, Nirṇayasindhu,

frequently used to designate his principal work.
